stdio_review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
stdio_review.algorithm_assessment: Track the total value of spendable non-500-yen coins, and for each such balance keep the largest saved-coin count then smallest souvenir expense. Paying with bills supplies change r=(-price) mod 1000. One 500-yen coin is obtainable iff the existing small-coin balance plus r is at least 500; enough small coins can be handed over without overshooting the required threshold by 500 because every spendable denomination is at most 100. The new balance is old+r-500 when saving, otherwise old+r. Saving whenever possible dominates declining that coin: it trades exactly 500 of future spendable value for one already secured coin, and any future opportunity can at worst exchange the same one coin. Each shop has skip/buy transitions, and lexicographic dominance at identical balances is safe for every future suffix.
stdio_review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
